entries.title: Republic of Anataria
entries.desc: A unitary republic east of the Kalyon Sea.
entries.lead: The Republic of Anataria is a unitary republic occupying a large peninsula and interior plateaus east of the Kalyon Sea, with its capital at Arkent. Its western border adjoins Elonia, its southern coast borders the Kalyon Sea, and its northern frontier extends into the Avren mainland.

entries.title: Republic of Elonia
entries.desc: A maritime republic west of the Kalyon Sea.
entries.lead: The Republic of Elonia is a unitary maritime nation situated west of the Kalyon Sea along the southwestern fringe of the Avren mainland, with its capital at Lerya.

entries.title: SKYFORTRESS-4
entries.desc: Satellite control, launch preparation and the center of the conflict.
entries.lead: SKYFORTRESS-4 is a satellite control and launch complex operated by Republic of Anataria. The planned launch of the KARTAL-7 military reconnaissance satellite from the site aboard SIMSEK-III places the facility at the center of Republic of Elonia’s attack.

entries.title: Sarpburun Peninsula
entries.desc: A strategic coastal peninsula connected to mainland Anataria in the east.
entries.lead: Sarpburun Peninsula is a coastal projection extending westward from the mainland of Republic of Anataria into Kalyon Sea. It is continuously connected to the main peninsula by the isthmus in the east; it is not an island. The SKYFORTRESS-4 satellite control and launch complex stands on the peninsula.

entries.title: Kalyon Sea
entries.desc: The setting for the maritime tensions between the two countries.
entries.lead: The Kalyon Sea stretches between Republic of Elonia to the west and Republic of Anataria to the east. Kalyon Islands lie in the southern part of the sea. The region is a center of maritime trade and sovereignty disputes between the two countries.
facts: Republic of Anataria · Republic of Elonia

entries.title: Kalyon Islands
entries.desc: The island group associated with the Kalyon Sea.
entries.lead: The Kalyon Islands are an island group associated with Kalyon Sea. Monitoring island bases and military deployments is one of the principal issues in the crisis between Republic of Anataria and Republic of Elonia.

entries.title: GOZCU-3
entries.desc: A surveillance and data relay satellite operating in orbit.
entries.lead: GOZCU-3 is the surveillance and data relay satellite in Republic of Anataria’s space program that is already in orbit. It is associated with the existing satellite operations of the SKYFORTRESS-4 complex.

entries.title: KARTAL-7
entries.desc: A new military reconnaissance satellite awaiting launch.
entries.lead: KARTAL-7 is a new military reconnaissance satellite that Republic of Anataria plans to launch from the SKYFORTRESS-4 complex aboard SIMSEK-III. The launch preparations are the fundamental cause of the conflict with Republic of Elonia.

entries.title: SIMSEK-III
entries.desc: The launch vehicle intended to carry KARTAL-7.
entries.lead: SIMSEK-III is the launch vehicle intended to carry the KARTAL-7 military reconnaissance satellite into space from the SKYFORTRESS-4 complex.

entries.title: AIGAION Battle Group
entries.desc: The combined naval force dispatched by Elonia to Sarpburun.
entries.lead: The AIGAION Battle Group is the naval group dispatched by Republic of Elonia toward Sarpburun Peninsula. The frigates AIGAION and THALASSA, NEREUS Landing Ship and KALLISTO Supply Ship are its principal components. During SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis, they jointly perform maritime surveillance, escort, force transport and logistics duties.

entries.title: 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron
entries.desc: An Anatarian air squadron founded in 1978; the legacy of DAGGER 06 and Black November.
entries.lead: The 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron is an Republic of Anataria air unit established in 1978 to provide air defense for the Sarpburun region. It uses the call sign “Dagger.” Regarded as one of the symbols of Anatarian air superiority, the squadron is known both for its role in the defense of SKYFORTRESS-4 and for DAGGER 06, which disappeared on 17 November 1994, and the commemorative plaque at its headquarters.

entries.title: 28th Zephyr Mobile Air Defense Battalion
entries.desc: An Elonian mobile coastal and island air defense battalion.
entries.lead: The 28th Zephyr Mobile Air Defense Battalion belongs to the Republic of Elonia Air Force mobile air defense and surveillance network over Lerya Bay and the western Kalyon Islands. During SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis it deployed mobile batteries protecting the coastal return route of the AIGAION Battle Group task group; it did not directly take part in operations over SKYFORTRESS-4.

entries.title: SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis
entries.desc: The conflict surrounding the KARTAL-7 launch.
entries.lead: The SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis is a political and security crisis that became an armed conflict when the government of Republic of Elonia decided to go to war against Republic of Anataria. The Sarpburun Dossier was presented as the official justification for war; the operation’s principal objective was to prevent the launch of the KARTAL-7 reconnaissance satellite from the SKYFORTRESS-4 complex. Northern Belt Defense Pact did not participate militarily in the war because of disagreements surrounding the forged documents.

entries.title: Northern Belt Defense Pact
entries.desc: An alliance for the collective defense and security of its member states.
entries.lead: The Northern Belt Defense Pact (KKSP) is an alliance providing collective defense and military coordination among Republic of Anataria, Republic of Elonia, Federation of Velaria, Republic of Dalmeria, Republic of Vardena and Federation of Rovenia. The pact’s military remit is separate from the institutions of Avren Union. Republic of Kipraya and North Kipraya Republic are not pact members. War between two member states during SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis has deadlocked the collective defense decision-making process.
facts: Republic of Anataria · Republic of Elonia · Federation of Velaria · Republic of Dalmeria · Republic of Vardena · Federation of Rovenia

entries.title: Elonia National Intelligence Directorate
entries.desc: Elonya’s foreign intelligence and strategic assessment agency.
entries.lead: The Elonia National Intelligence Directorate (EUID) is the intelligence agency that supplies foreign security assessments to the government of Republic of Elonia. The Sarpburun Dossier it prepared under Glass Curtain was decisive in constructing the political justification for war with Republic of Anataria.

entries.title: Sarpburun Dossier
entries.desc: The collection of forged documents presented by Elonia as its justification for war.
entries.lead: The Sarpburun Dossier is the collective name for forged documents prepared by Elonia National Intelligence Directorate under Glass Curtain and presented as if they belonged to the government of Republic of Anataria. The dossier alleged that Anataria was planning a first strike around Kalyon Islands and was used by the government of Republic of Elonia as its justification for declaring war.
facts: Justification for war and deadlock in alliance decisions

entries.title: Glass Curtain
entries.desc: The covert political influence activity based on preparing the Sarpburun Dossier.
entries.lead: Glass Curtain is the code name of the covert activity conducted by Elonia National Intelligence Directorate to construct a justification for war against Republic of Anataria. Its principal product was Sarpburun Dossier, and it aimed to create political uncertainty that would prevent joint military intervention within Northern Belt Defense Pact.
facts: Justifying war and delaying an alliance decision

entries.title: Avren mainland
entries.desc: The northwestern mainland connected to Elonia and Anataria’s Avren side.
entries.lead: Avren is the northwestern mainland encompassing Federation of Velaria, Republic of Dalmeria, Republic of Vardena, Federation of Rovenia and Republic of Elonia, as well as Anataria’s territory west of the strait. Republic of Anataria and Republic of Elonia share a land border west of Istara.
facts: Republic of Elonia · Republic of Anataria

entries.title: Istara
entries.desc: The strait city connecting Anataria’s two shores.
entries.lead: Istara is a port and transit city within Republic of Anataria that developed around Istara Strait. The settlement extends between the Avren side and the main peninsula. Linking the shores of two continents, the city is one of the region’s most important trade passages. Anataria’s capital is Arkent.

entries.title: Istara Strait
entries.desc: The narrow waterway connecting the Northern Sea and the Inland Sea.
entries.lead: The Istara Strait is a narrow maritime chokepoint connecting the exit of the Kalyon Sea to southern shipping routes along the Avren mainland.

entries.title: Federation of Velaria
entries.desc: A regional state in northwestern Avren.
entries.lead: The Federation of Velaria is a state in northwestern Avren with its capital at Veler. It is a federation that developed along extensive northwestern coasts and inland industrial basins. Port cities, financial centers and advanced manufacturing regions form the backbone of its economy. It is a member of Northern Belt Defense Pact and Avren Union.

entries.title: Republic of Dalmeria
entries.desc: A regional state on the western Avren coast.
entries.lead: The Republic of Dalmeria is a state on the western Avren coast with its capital at Dalmera. It occupies a long peninsula extending southward from western Avren. There are pronounced economic and cultural differences between its coastal cities and mountainous interior. It is a member of Northern Belt Defense Pact and Avren Union.

entries.title: Republic of Vardena
entries.desc: A regional state in central Avren’s transition belt.
entries.lead: The Republic of Vardena is a state in central Avren’s transition belt with its capital at Vardis. It lies north of Elonia around mountain passes and river basins. Land routes between western and eastern Avren determine the country’s strategic value. It is a member of Northern Belt Defense Pact and Avren Union.

entries.title: Federation of Rovenia
entries.desc: A regional state in northeastern Avren.
entries.lead: The Federation of Rovenia is a state in northeastern Avren with its capital at Roven. It is a broad federation opening onto the western and northern shores of the Northern Sea. Forested plateaus, river cities and northern ports form distinct economic regions. It is a member of Northern Belt Defense Pact and Avren Union.

entries.title: Republic of Kipraya
entries.desc: An Avren Union member republic governing the south of Kipraya island.
entries.lead: The Republic of Kipraya is a state on Kipraya Island, south of the coast of Republic of Anataria. The government recognized across the island in practice administers its southern part; North Kipraya Republic has established a separate administration in the north. The capital, Kipra, is divided by Kipraya Buffer Line, which separates the two parts. The republic is a member of Avren Union, but not of Northern Belt Defense Pact.

entries.title: Avren Union
entries.desc: A political and economic union bringing together the Avren countries and Kipraya.
entries.lead: The Avren Union (AB) is an interstate union working in the areas of a common market, movement, trade standards and regional development. Its members are Federation of Velaria, Republic of Dalmeria, Republic of Vardena, Federation of Rovenia, Republic of Elonia and Republic of Kipraya. The union’s political and economic institutions are separate from the military structure of Northern Belt Defense Pact.
facts: Federation of Velaria · Republic of Dalmeria · Republic of Vardena · Federation of Rovenia · Republic of Elonia · Republic of Kipraya
Partnership and customs agreements; not a full member
Avren Council · Common Assembly · Union Commission

entries.title: K-16 Alaz
entries.desc: Anatarya’s single-engine multirole fighter aircraft.
entries.lead: The K-16 Alaz is a single-pilot, single-engine multirole fighter aircraft used by Republic of Anataria’s air force. It is the principal platform of the modernization that began in 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron squadron in 2019. It serves in protecting the airspace around SKYFORTRESS-4.

entries.title: UT-7 Ilgaz
entries.desc: Utility helicopter.
entries.lead: The UT-7 Ilgaz is a utility helicopter platform used by Republic of Anataria. It is suitable for personnel transport, search and rescue, and medical evacuation missions. It provides transport support to the Sarp Guard unit as required.

entries.title: Kalkan HSS
entries.desc: Mobile air defense system.
entries.lead: The Kalkan HSS is a mobile air defense system platform used by Republic of Anataria. It is a family of systems comprising radar, a command vehicle and air defense vehicles.
facts: Varies by vehicle and mission crew

entries.title: M-12 Aster
entries.desc: Multirole fighter aircraft.
entries.lead: The M-12 Aster is a multirole fighter aircraft platform used by Republic of Elonia. Elonia uses it for air defense and air support to naval forces. It is the principal platform of the 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment.

entries.title: P-8 Pelagos
entries.desc: Maritime patrol aircraft.
entries.lead: The P-8 Pelagos is a maritime patrol aircraft platform used by Republic of Elonia. It is a turboprop aircraft assigned to maritime observation, search-and-rescue coordination and long-duration patrols. It provides information support to the AIGAION group; it is not part of a fighter squadron’s organic inventory.

entries.title: Triton Fast Boat
entries.desc: Fast personnel transport boat.
entries.lead: The Triton Fast Boat is a fast personnel transport boat platform used by Republic of Elonia. It is used for short-distance sea transport, coastal patrols and personnel transfers. It is operated by the Nereus Naval Commando Group.

entries.title: AIGAION-class Frigate
entries.desc: Multipurpose frigate.
entries.lead: The AIGAION-class Frigate is a multipurpose frigate platform used by Republic of Elonia. AIGAION and THALASSA belong to this frigate class. It undertakes the battle group’s escort, maritime surveillance and command liaison duties.

entries.title: NEREUS Landing Ship
entries.desc: Amphibious transport and support ship.
entries.lead: The NEREUS Landing Ship is an amphibious transport and support ship platform used by Republic of Elonia. It is an amphibious ship carrying personnel, vehicles and support supplies. It shares its name with the 8th Nereus Naval Commando Group, but the ship and unit are separate entities.
facts: AIGAION Battle Group · 8th Nereus Naval Commando Group

entries.title: KALLISTO Supply Ship
entries.desc: Naval logistics ship.
entries.lead: The KALLISTO Supply Ship is a naval logistics ship platform used by Republic of Elonia. It supports the battle group’s requirements for fuel, provisions and maintenance supplies. It helps the group sustain a prolonged presence at sea.

entries.title: 4th Sarp Guard Company
entries.desc: A facility protection and response unit of the Anatarian forces.
entries.lead: A company tasked with military security and response, protecting critical infrastructure on Sarpburun Peninsula. It focuses on the mainland connection, personnel safety and maintaining civilian evacuation arrangements during the crisis.

entries.title: 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment
entries.desc: A carrier-capable tactical strike detachment of the Elonian air forces.
entries.lead: A multirole strike detachment of Elonia’s air force. It conducts air strike and suppression missions in the area where the AIGAION Battle Group group operates. It is a separate organization from the maritime patrol aircraft.

entries.title: 8th Nereus Naval Commando Group
entries.desc: A naval special mission unit of the Elonian forces.
entries.lead: One of Elonia’s special units operating in the maritime environment. It conducts activities such as personnel protection, movement by sea and search-and-rescue support on missions attached to the AIGAION Battle Group group.

entries.title: K-4 Boran
entries.desc: Dagger squadron’s historic twin-engine interceptor.
entries.lead: The K-4 Boran is a two-crew, twin-engine interceptor and tactical mission aircraft of Republic of Anataria’s air force. It was the first principal platform of 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron squadron, established in 1978. DAGGER 06, which disappeared on 17 November 1994, belongs to this aircraft family.

entries.title: North Kipraya Republic
entries.desc: The administration in northern Kipraya island, recognized only by Anataria.
entries.lead: The North Kipraya Republic is a state governed through separate institutions in the north of Kipraya Island. Its independence is recognized only by Republic of Anataria. The government of Republic of Kipraya and Avren Union regard the north as part of the Republic of Kipraya. Its administrative center is North Kipra.

entries.title: Kipraya Island
entries.desc: An island in the Southern Sea divided between two administrations and a buffer line.
entries.lead: Kipraya is an island south of the coast of Republic of Anataria and at the southeastern outlet of Kalyon Sea. Republic of Kipraya administers its southern part and North Kipraya Republic its northern part. The Kipraya Buffer Line between the two administrations also runs through the capital, Kipra.

entries.title: Kipraya Buffer Line
entries.desc: The monitoring zone separating the northern and southern administrations.
entries.lead: The Kipraya Buffer Line is a monitoring zone established to preserve the ceasefire arrangements on Kipraya Island. It extends between Republic of Kipraya and North Kipraya Republic and divides the city of Kipra in two. The line is monitored by the neutral Ceasefire Observation Mission.

entries.title: 6th Northern Signal Battalion
entries.desc: Anatarya’s Sarpburun communications and early warning unit.
entries.lead: The 6th Northern Signal Battalion combines radar data, radio traffic and civil warnings for Republic of Anataria forces on the Sarpburun Peninsula peninsula. It provides a common operational picture for forces protecting SKYFORTRESS-4.
facts: 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron · 4th Sarp Guard Company

entries.title: 18th Doruk Supply Regiment
entries.desc: Anatarya’s supply unit for the peninsula road corridor.
entries.lead: The 18th Doruk Supply Regiment manages fuel, medical supplies and maintenance shipments from the Republic of Anataria interior to the passes of Sarpburun Peninsula. Its network helps sustain SKYFORTRESS-4.
facts: ARMED FORCES · spawns at the garrison logistics HQ

entries.title: 3rd Pelagos Maritime Patrol Squadron
entries.desc: Elonya’s maritime surveillance squadron in the Kalyon Sea.
entries.lead: The 3rd Pelagos Maritime Patrol Squadron monitors traffic between the Republic of Elonia coast and the Kalyon Islands with P-8 Pelagos aircraft. It has a separate command and mission structure from the 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment strike detachment.

entries.title: 27th Iron Fist Heavy Armored Division
entries.desc: Anatarya’s heavy armored division defending the land approaches to Sarpburun.
entries.lead: The 27th Iron Fist Heavy Armored Division is an Republic of Anataria Army maneuver unit stationed at the land passes leading onto the Sarpburun Peninsula peninsula. It operates heavy main battle tanks under a command separate from the 4th Sarp Guard Company company responsible for security inside SKYFORTRESS-4.

entries.title: 9th Iris Airborne Brigade
entries.desc: Elonya’s airborne brigade assigned to the island chain.
entries.lead: The 9th Iris Airborne Brigade is a rapidly deployable unit of the Republic of Elonia Army. Its mission area covers the western Kalyon Islands and airfields on the Elonian mainland. It is organizationally separate from the 8th Nereus Naval Commando Group naval units serving with the AIGAION Battle Group group.

entries.title: Sarpburun Radar Station
entries.desc: Anatarya's early warning radar installation overlooking Sarpburun and the Kalyon Sea.
entries.lead: Sarpburun Radar Station is an Republic of Anataria early warning and coastal surveillance facility perched upon the high ridges of the Sarpburun Peninsula peninsula. Located on the bluffs east of the SKYFORTRESS-4 complex, it is operated by 6th Northern Signal Battalion. It relays real-time radar tracks of the Kalyon Sea and approach corridors to 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron and air defense forces.
facts: 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron · Kalkan HSS · SKYFORTRESS-4

entries.title: Black November Incident
entries.desc: The mysterious disappearance of DAGGER 06 off Sarpburun on 17 November 1994.
entries.lead: The Black November Incident was a military aviation mystery occurring on 17 November 1994, when an Republic of Anataria Air Force K-4 Boran flying under callsign DAGGER 06 from the 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron vanished from radar off the coast of Sarpburun Peninsula. Just 11 seconds after its last radio transmission, all radar and telemetry contact ceased; no trace of the airframe or its two-man crew was ever recovered. The event sparked a lasting squadron tradition and formed the basis of the Classified File 94-117 investigation.
facts: Pilot Captain and Weapons System Officer

entries.title: Classified File 94-117
entries.desc: Top secret investigation into the loss of DAGGER 06 and the 2036 beacon transmission.
entries.lead: Classified File 94-117 is a restricted dossier maintained by the Republic of Anataria Air Force Command and Intelligence Directorate investigating the 17 November 1994 loss of DAGGER 06 and the anomalous transmission received on identical frequencies in 2036. The file compiles telemetry logs, radar strip charts, signal intercepts, and assessments of potential electronic warfare by Elonia National Intelligence Directorate.
facts: Anatarya Air Force and Intelligence Directorate
132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron · 6th Northern Signal Battalion

entries.title: United States of Ostania
entries.desc: Transoceanic superpower and operator of the ARGUS global positioning constellation.
entries.lead: The United States of Ostania (USO) is a transoceanic military, technological, and economic superpower occupying a vast continent west of Avren. As the champion of maritime free trade and cutting-edge aerospace standards, Ostania commands nuclear supercarrier strike groups and operates the ARGUS satellite constellation, projecting undisputed naval and orbital presence. A close strategic partner of Republic of Elonia, Ostania declared 'freedom of navigation patrols' in the Kalyon Sea during the SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis, dispatching guided missile cruisers and nuclear attack submarines to the periphery.
facts: Republic of Elonia · Northern Belt Defense Pact

entries.title: Ursian Federation
entries.desc: Continental superpower spanning northern tundras with vast heavy industry and nuclear arsenals.
entries.lead: The Ursian Federation is a vast continental superpower spanning the frozen tundras, taiga, and interior mountain ranges northeast of Avren. Holding the world's largest landmass and colossal energy reserves, Ursya is recognized for heavy metallurgy, rocket propulsion, and strategic deterrence. Historically maintaining balanced defense ties with Republic of Anataria, Ursya licensed the engine designs and baseline telemetry for Anataria's workhorse K-4 Boran strike jets and heavy space launch stages.
facts: K-4 Boran jet engines · Heavy rocket stages

entries.title: People's Republic of Huaxia
entries.desc: Eastern manufacturing, microelectronics, and orbital component titan.
entries.lead: The People's Republic of Huaxia is an eastern industrial titan and demographic heavyweight serving as the primary foundry of global electronics. Producing the lion's share of high-purity silicon wafers, rare earth minerals, and solar array wafers, Huaxia supplied the dense photovoltaic cells and optical beam splitters utilized on SKYFORTRESS-4.

entries.title: ANASAS Aerospace
entries.desc: Anataria Aerospace Industries; the nation's premier aircraft and launch system prime contractor.
entries.lead: ANASAS (Anataria Aerospace Industries) is the industrial cornerstone of Republic of Anataria's sovereignty in the skies and orbital space. Founded following historical foreign arms embargoes, the company is the lead integrator of the K-21 KAAN 5th-generation stealth fighter, the SIMSEK-III space launch vehicle, and the primary bus structures for the SKYFORTRESS-4 satellite constellation.
facts: SARPSAN Electronics · KORSAN Missile Systems · Baykut Defense Technologies

entries.title: Baykut Defense Technologies
entries.desc: Pioneer of autonomous combat drones, AI flight algorithms, and unmanned stealth aircraft.
entries.lead: Baykut Defense Technologies is a world-renowned Republic of Anataria defense firm pioneering armed unmanned aerial vehicles (UCAVs) and autonomous combat systems. Producing the iconic BAYRAK-T2 tactical drone, the twin-turboprop AKIN-3 heavy strike drone, and the AL-ELMA K-01 supersonic unmanned stealth jet, Baykut has fundamentally transformed modern maritime and aerial warfare doctrines.
facts: Autonomous flight · Machine vision · Loyal wingman swarming

entries.title: SARPSAN Electronics
entries.desc: National designer of phased-array radars, electronic warfare suites, and electro-optical sensors.
entries.lead: SARPSAN (Sarpburun Defense Electronics) is the premier electronic warfare and radar design house for the Republic of Anataria Armed Forces. It designs the phased-array surveillance radars at Sarpburun Radar Station, the nose-mounted AESA radar for the K-21 KAAN, and optical targeting pods deployed across unmanned fleets.
facts: Sarpburun Radar Station · Kalkan HSS · K-21 KAAN

entries.title: KORSAN Missile Systems
entries.desc: Manufacturer of solid rocket motors, air defense interceptors, and precision smart munitions.
entries.lead: KORSAN (Kor Munitions & Rocket Systems) is the primary rocket propulsion and guided ordnance contractor in Republic of Anataria. It manufactures interceptors for the Kalkan HSS system, solid-propellant booster stages for the SIMSEK-III space rocket, and laser-guided micro-munitions for the BAYRAK-T2 fleet.
facts: Kalkan interceptor missiles · MAM precision glide munitions

entries.title: K-21 KAAN
entries.desc: Anataria’s twin-engine, low-observable 5th-generation national combat stealth fighter.
entries.lead: The K-21 KAAN is a twin-engine, super-cruising, low-observable (stealth) 5th-generation air superiority and deep strike fighter developed by ANASAS Aerospace for the Republic of Anataria Air Force. Featuring internal weapons bays, an advanced SARPSAN Electronics AESA radar, and an integrated helmet-mounted cueing system, the KAAN replaces legacy K-4 Boran aircraft. During the 2036 SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis, initial operational prototypes were mobilized at Arkent Air Base, conducting deterrent combat patrols over Sarpburun and the Kalyon Sea.
facts: ANASAS Aerospace (avionics: SARPSAN Electronics · KORSAN Missile Systems)
Republic of Anataria Air Force (132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron)
SARPSAN Nose AESA Radar · Electro-Optical Targeting (EOTS)

entries.title: BAYRAK-T2
entries.desc: Anataria’s 27-hour endurance tactical armed reconnaissance drone system.
entries.lead: The BAYRAK-T2 is a medium-altitude long-endurance (MALE) tactical unmanned combat aerial vehicle developed by Baykut Defense Technologies Defense. Characterized by its inverted V-tail, redundant avionics, and autonomous triple-redundant flight control, the T2 carries four laser-guided smart micro-munitions engineered by KORSAN Missile Systems. Throughout the 2036 SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis, T2 squadrons maintained relentless day-and-night surveillance over the Kalyon Sea and the Istara Strait.
facts: Republic of Anataria Army, Navy & Air Force

entries.title: AKIN-3
entries.desc: Twin-turboprop heavy strategic strike UCAV capable of launching standoff cruise missiles.
entries.lead: The AKIN-3 is a high-altitude long-endurance (HALE) twin-turboprop heavy strike unmanned aerial vehicle developed by Baykut Defense Technologies Defense. Boasting an unprecedented 1,500 kg payload capacity comparable to light attack jets, the AKIN-3 features a nose AESA radar, satellite communications link, and carriage capability for standoff cruise missiles.

entries.title: AL-ELMA K-01
entries.desc: AI-driven supersonic unmanned stealth combat fighter jet.
entries.lead: The AL-ELMA K-01 is a single-engine supersonic unmanned combat stealth fighter (UCAV-Jet) engineered by Baykut Defense Technologies Defense. Designed with low-observable canards, radar-absorbent materials, and an aggressive flight envelope, AL-ELMA is crafted for autonomous air-to-air dogfighting, air defense suppression (SEAD), and cooperative 'loyal wingman' operations alongside the manned K-21 KAAN.
facts: Loyal wingman to K-21 KAAN · Autonomous dogfighting
Conventional runways and short-deck amphibious carriers

entries.title: Pelagos Forward Coast Guard Station
entries.desc: Elonia's forward coast guard outpost on the western approach to the Kalyon Islands.
entries.lead: A forward monitoring outpost and rapid-interception patrol boat station operated by Elonia on the western approaches to the Kalyon Islands.

entries.title: Kalyon Mariners' Memorial Lighthouse
entries.desc: A memorial lighthouse for sailors lost in the 2026 Kalyon naval clash.
entries.lead: A navigational beacon and memorial lighthouse erected in remembrance of the naval casualties of the 2026 Kalyon Sea skirmish.

entries.title: Kalyon Air Defense & Missile Battery (KOR-KALKAN)
entries.desc: A long-range air defense battery guarding SKYFORTRESS-4 and Sarpburun airspace.
entries.lead: A long-range surface-to-air missile installation operated by Anataria, safeguarding Sarpburun airspace and SKYFORTRESS-4 from standoff aerial and missile strikes.
facts: Kalkan HSS, KORSAN Missile Systems Hisar-K Interceptor Missiles

entries.title: Lerya 5th Tactical Jet Base (Pelican)
entries.desc: Elonia's tactical air base on the Kalyon coast.
entries.lead: The Republic of Elonia's primary tactical air base on the Kalyon coast, conducting island air patrols and coastal air defense.

entries.title: Sarpburun Gate Suspension Bridge
entries.desc: A fortified bridge and land crossing connecting the Sarpburun Peninsula to mainland Anataria.
entries.lead: The strategic heavy suspension bridge and fortified causeway linking the Sarpburun Peninsula to mainland Anataria; the lifeline of SKYFORTRESS-4 logistics.

entries.title: Istara Strait Coastal Defense Garrison
entries.desc: Anatarian coastal defense garrison controlling the Istara Strait.
entries.lead: An Anatarian coastal defense garrison equipped with shore-to-ship missiles and surface surveillance radars guarding maritime transit through the Istara Strait.
facts: KORSAN Missile Systems Atmaca-K Coastal Defense Missiles, 76 mm Coastal Guns
Istara Vessel Traffic Service Radar Tower

entries.title: Lerya Naval Headquarters & Pelagos Fleet Base
entries.desc: The Elonian navy's principal Kalyon Sea operating base.
entries.lead: The primary naval operating base, drydock shipyard, and frigate flotilla station for the Republic of Elonia Navy in the Kalyon Sea.
facts: 1st Frigate Flotilla, Kalyon Fast Attack Craft Division

entries.title: Arkent 1st Main Jet Base Command (Karakartal)
entries.desc: The main fighter base for Anataria's capital defense and western air operations.
entries.lead: The premier fighter air base defending Anataria's capital and western operational theater, home to K-21 KAAN, K16-Alaz, and unmanned combat fighter squadrons.
facts: 101st Karakartal Squadron (K-21 KAAN), 132nd Dagger Squadron (K-16 Alaz), 14th Unmanned Fighter Squadron (AL-ELMA K-01)

entries.title: Sarpburun Early Warning Radar Complex (SARP-RAD)
entries.desc: An early warning radar and electronic warfare complex on Sarpburun's northern ridge.
entries.lead: An active electronically scanned array (AESA) early warning and electronic warfare complex deployed on the northern crest of the Sarpburun Peninsula, monitoring a 600 km radius across the Kalyon Sea and Avren airspace.

entries.title: ALTAI MBT
entries.desc: Heavy main battle tank of the 27th Iron Fist Heavy Armored Division.
entries.lead: The ALTAI MBT (lore name Altay) is the heavy main battle tank of 27th Iron Fist Heavy Armored Division, modeled on the Altay T1. It is a four-man tank with a 120 mm smoothbore gun, an active protection system and a dedicated driver station, and only Iron Fist crews may drive it.
facts: 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun · 12.7 mm SARP remote weapon station

entries.title: Dolphin RHIB
entries.desc: Rigid-hull inflatable boat of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
entries.lead: The Dolphin RHIB is the smallest vessel of the 3rd Coast Guard Command, a rigid-hull inflatable boat about 30 studs long used for patrols, boarding and rescue in the Rockcove bay and the sea beyond. Four boats, CG-3R1 to CG-3R4, are based at the station.

entries.title: Seagull FPB
entries.desc: Fast patrol boat of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
entries.lead: The Seagull-class fast patrol boat is the mid-size vessel of the 3rd Coast Guard Command, about 75 studs long with a deep-V hull, an enclosed bridge and a 12.7 mm remote-controlled weapon at the bow. Three boats, CG-331 to CG-333, are based at Rockcove.

entries.title: Northwind OPV
entries.desc: Offshore patrol vessel, the largest ship of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
entries.lead: The Northwind-class offshore patrol vessel is the flagship type of the 3rd Coast Guard Command. Two ships serve at Rockcove: CG-301 NORTHWIND and CG-302 STORMRIDER. At about 165 studs they are the largest vessels of Anataria’s coast guard.

entries.title: Sarp South Shelter
entries.desc: Deep military bunker cut into the Sarp mountain range, used as an evacuation shelter.
entries.lead: The Sarp South Shelter is a deep military shelter excavated into the Sarp mountain range at the eastern edge of the region. A long tunnel with a bend, a blast lock and a vehicle hall lead to a main corridor with eleven rooms. During a catastrophe alarm it is the place where the facility’s personnel are evacuated to survive the blast.
facts: Sarp mountain range, eastern edge of the region
Portal with a 24 × 20 stud blast door

entries.title: Rockcove Coast Guard Station
entries.desc: Naval base on the southwestern bay of Sarpburun, home of the 3rd Coast Guard Command.
entries.lead: Rockcove Coast Guard Station is the base of the 3rd Coast Guard Command on the east shore of a bay southwest of SKYFORTRESS-4. It consists of two levels, an upper terrace with the headquarters and a lower quay with berths for nine ships.

entries.title: Sarpburun Air Base
entries.desc: Home base of the 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron with four hardened shelters and a hidden mountain hangar.
entries.lead: Sarpburun Air Base is the airfield of the 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron squadron, rebuilt on 10 November on its original site. It has a 2,400-stud runway, a parallel taxiway, four hardened aircraft shelters, a headquarters building and, at the east end of the runway, a hidden hangar cut into the mountain that is reserved for the squadron’s most elite aircraft.

entries.title: Karadere Village
entries.desc: Two-neighborhood hillside village around a clock tower square and a monument roundabout.
entries.lead: Karadere is a village on the hinterland roads of Sarpburun Peninsula, laid out as two orderly neighborhoods linked by asphalt streets with sidewalks. Its center is a square with a clock tower, and the crossing of the Karadere and Liman roads is a roundabout with a limestone monument that is also the center of the village’s capture zone.
facts: At least 44, of which at least 10 can be entered
Island radius 9 studs, monument and “KARADERE” plaque

entries.title: 3rd Coast Guard Command
entries.desc: Anatarya’s coastal patrol and rescue command based at Rockcove.
entries.lead: The 3rd Coast Guard Command is a unit of the Anatarya Coast Guard Command, the body that also operates Istara. It was established in 2029 with the construction of SKYFORTRESS-4 and patrols the restricted sea area on the sea side of the facility, intercepts Republic of Elonia reconnaissance and landing craft and carries out search and rescue. In the crisis it is the first line of defense on the coast.
facts: Navy blue and white with a pale orange stripe (team color “Storm blue”)

entries.title: Shift system
entries.desc: The continuous 15-minute shift cycle of launch preparation, sabotage and catastrophe.
entries.lead: The server of the Skyfortress Military Facility game never ends a match. It runs one shift after another, each about 900 seconds long, until the SIMSEK-III launch window at the end of the shift decides who gains experience. The defenders (Republic of Anataria: soldiers and facility staff) try to prepare and launch KARTAL-7; the attackers (Republic of Elonia) try to stop the launch, and if they cause a catastrophe the whole facility rushes to the shelters.
facts: T-0 at the end of the Active phase
Armed forces and facility staff of Republic of Anataria
Sarp South Shelter · Main Control shelter floor

entries.title: Vehicle bays
entries.desc: How vehicles, aircraft and ships are called, parked and recalled.
entries.lead: Vehicles of the Skyfortress Military Facility game are not found lying around the map; they are called from numbered vehicle bays in the garages beside each unit’s headquarters, shelters and berths of each unit. A bay panel opens a menu that lists the vehicles the player’s unit may call, with their rank requirements and cooldowns.
facts: Garages, hangar shelters and ship berths
Vehicle Bay prompt, vehicle list, 3D preview, DEPLOY
One vehicle per player at a time
30 seconds without a driver, unless parked

entries.title: Day–night cycle
entries.desc: The 48-minute cycle of dawn, day, dusk and night with a real sun and moon.
entries.lead: The Skyfortress Military Facility game has a shared day–night cycle: every player sees the same time of day, and the sun and moon move smoothly across the sky of Sarpburun Peninsula. The facility’s outdoor lamps come on at dusk and go off at dawn, except during a power outage.
facts: Two thirds: about 32 minutes of day and 16 of night

entries.title: Divisions and ranks
entries.desc: The units players can join, their sub-units and the rank requirements for vehicles.
entries.lead: Players of the Skyfortress Military Facility game choose a division on the team selection screen, which has three columns: ARMED FORCES, FACILITY STAFF and HOSTILES. Each division is a separate team with its own spawn point, uniform and vehicles. Capacity is enforced only by the server and never shown on screen.
facts: 4th Sarp Guard Company · 27th Iron Fist Heavy Armored Division · 132nd Dagger Tactical Squadron · 6th Northern Signal Battalion · 3rd Coast Guard Command · 18th Doruk Supply Regiment · AIA [CLASSIFIED] · 22nd SRS [CLASSIFIED]
Launch Scientists · Maintenance Crew · Logistics Crew
8th Nereus Naval Commandos · 9th Iris Airborne Brigade · 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment · 28th Zephyr Mobile Air Defense Battalion
Divisions can be changed every 10 seconds

entries.title: USOS Meridian (CVN-96)
entries.desc: Ostanian nuclear supercarrier deployed off Sarpburun with Elonia’s air wing embarked.
entries.lead: USOS Meridian (CVN-96) is a Meridian-class nuclear-powered supercarrier of the United States of Ostania 7th Ocean Fleet. During the SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis it was sent into the Kalyon Sea and placed at the service of Republic of Elonia: the ship, its catapults and its deck crew remain Ostanian, while the fighters that launch from its deck belong to Elonia’s 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment. It gives the AIGAION Battle Group the airfield at sea that Elonia, which has no carrier of its own, could not otherwise field.
facts: Kalyon Sea, with the AIGAION Battle Group
38th Gorgon Strike Detachment (M-12 Aster M-12N) · Ostanian support aircraft

entries.title: EW-4 Halcyon
entries.desc: Ostanian carrier-based airborne early warning aircraft.
entries.lead: The EW-4 Halcyon is a twin-turboprop airborne early warning aircraft of the United States of Ostania navy, designed to operate from aircraft carriers. A rotating radar dome above the fuselage lets it watch the sea and the sky far beyond the horizon of a ship’s own sensors. Two Halcyons fly from USOS Meridian (CVN-96) during the SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis.

entries.title: SH-70 Petrel
entries.desc: Ostanian shipborne multi-mission helicopter.
entries.lead: The SH-70 Petrel is a twin-engine multi-mission helicopter of the United States of Ostania navy. Aboard USOS Meridian (CVN-96) it flies plane guard during launches and recoveries, carries out search and rescue and covers the carrier group against submarines.

entries.title: M-12N Aster
entries.desc: Carrier-capable version of the M-12 Aster, flown by Elonia from USOS Meridian.
entries.lead: The M-12N Aster is the navalized version of Elonia’s M-12 Aster multirole fighter. It was converted so that 38th Gorgon Strike Detachment could fly from the Ostanian supercarrier USOS Meridian (CVN-96) during the SKYFORTRESS-4 Crisis. The picture shows aircraft 38-201 of the detachment on the flight deck.
